SCIENCE ADVENTURE 17 · CLASS 31

Owl’s Shadow Science

Age 4–5 YearsClass 31 · ScienceSkill Light and shadows

A teddy, an airplane, a dinosaur — spot the true shadow each toy casts.

Play the science game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · LIGHT AND SHADOWS

Owl’s Shadow Science

A light shines on each toy and makes a shadow! Tap the shadow that really matches the toy.

The teddy bear’s shadow — which one is it?

The airplane’s shadow — which one is it?

The toy dinosaur’s shadow — which one is it?

Shadow detective!

Teddy’s shadow has round ears, the airplane’s has wings, and the dinosaur’s has a big tail!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Shadow matching is silhouette geometry — the outline is the only clue. Torch-and-hand puppet shadows are the perfect next step.

Prefer paper? The Owl’s Shadow Science worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
